pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and stellate geometries with highly jagged, serrated edges. Patches on the lower neck are larger and more elongated, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented, and rounded shapes on the posterior flank. Spatial area of dark regions is significantly greater than the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan interstitial pathways. Nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness but exhibit high tortuosity following the serrated margins of the patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristled silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. Mane consists of dense, dark vertical fibers creating a fine-textured jagged contour against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular, de-pigmented white focal lesion is visible on the mid-lower flank, creating a localized disruption in the typical pelage pattern.
